blockingLoop.evidence: Repeatedly asks to check vents and door seals after customer reported no frost, cold-less back wall and working fan; final turn again: 'Please check the rubber door seals on both doors'

rationale: The assistant correctly refused DIY regassing and linked the oily mark to a refrigerant leak, then suggested replacement as the cheaper option. It never mentioned that R600a is flammable (ventilation, ignition sources) despite the rating plate. It also kept looping back to vents and seals after the customer had ruled out airflow, and it ignored the knife-damage link to a puncture, so it was unhelpful on the customer's repeated cost question. Its advice to 'unplug' and its replacement-vs-engineer comparison was reasonable, but it gave no quote guidance and never said clearly that the engineer route would be uneconomic.
